name: APEX 2027 full-board Muse evidence assignment
goal: Maximize verified evidence coverage across all 201 players, not force stable projection labels.
read_me_first: Source received is only an intake receipt; 35 PFF-derived OL records have not yet been matched and model-validated.
Never call a projection GREEN simply because a dataset is filled.
Do not publish licensed raw PFF data in GitHub or the public APEX site; deliver locally under rights-respecting access.
Do not leak names or sensitive non-public medical details; stick to public injury and availability reporting.
For absences, keep stats null / no opportunity rather than imputing zero. 2026 nonparticipation can still have verified historical evaluation.
97 defensive players lack a current Translation Topology score. Evidence collection is necessary but extending and backtesting the model is an APEX engineering step, not a Muse-only step.
Return one machine-readable record per player keyed by apex_rank + name + season-specific school; report aliases and identity conflicts.

output_schema.name: string

2024.metrics: object with metric_name -> {value, unit, denominator, source_url, license, observed_at}

output_schema.release_policy: raw licensed values must be delivered privately under license; public extract should contain only authorized derived/non-sensitive fields
